name: dsh-cad-review
description: Evidence-first DXF extraction and deterministic CAD rule review for DeepSeek Harness and Codex

interface.shortDescription: Extract DXF evidence and run deterministic CAD checks.
interface.longDescription: Reads ASCII DXF into source-hashed structured evidence and reports rule violations with entity IDs, layers and coordinates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review this CAD drawing from structured DXF evidence and cite every finding by entity ID, layer, and location.
